title: Ito push notifications
description: What the server sends through Apple Push Notification service to a registered device, and only while you're not looking at Ito: when a reply finishes, when a turn fails, when Kumo asks you something or posts from background work, when a card starts waiting on you, and for the morning briefing. How loud each one is follows Kumo's shared manners: quiet during a calendar event, at most one with sound an hour, nothing non-urgent overnight, and urgent always sounds. The text is encrypted on the server with the device's notification key and decrypted on the device by Ito's notification service extension, so Apple sees only ciphertext.

Envelope.description: The APNs payload. `aps.alert` is what the device shows when it can't decrypt; the notification service extension replaces it with the decrypted `Notification`.

body.description: Plain words for when decryption fails, by kind: "Ari replied", "Ari couldn't finish", "Ari asked you something" or "Ari is still waiting on you", with the agent's name.

interruption-level.description: Set by the shared manners: `time-sensitive` for an ask or something urgent; `passive` (no sound) during a calendar event, overnight, or once one with sound went out in the last hour; `active` otherwise.

category.description: `ask` for an ask and its reminder, so the device can offer the options as actions.

v.description: The scheme: AES-256-GCM, with the device's id as additional data.

k.description: The key that encrypted it: the first 8 hex characters of the key's SHA-256, as in the device's `key_id`.

c.description: The `Notification` as UTF-8 JSON, encrypted, followed by the 16-byte tag, base64.

NotificationKind.description: Why the server pushed: a `reply` finished, a turn `failed`, the agent made an `ask`, or a `reminder` for an ask still waiting after three hours, sent once. `post`: Kumo posted into the conversation from background work. `card`: something started waiting on you on the Desk. `briefing`: the morning briefing is ready.

Notification.description: What the device shows, once decrypted.

text.description: `reply`: the reply's first line, with Markdown stripped, at most 200 characters. `failed`: "Couldn't finish: " and the error's message. `ask`: the question. `reminder`: "Still waiting on one thing: " and the question. `post`: its first line. `card`: the card's title. `briefing`: its first line.

message.description: `reply`: the reply, so that a tap opens the conversation there.

ask.description: `ask` and `reminder`: what the device needs to answer from the notification. Answering is an ordinary send.

card.description: `card`: the card, to open the Desk at it.
